prompt.generated_prompt_string: An extreme close-up eye-level macro beauty portrait of an adult woman in a coquette, soft-grunge, vintage-indie, romantic-macabre aesthetic. Her head tilts gently while her eyes look up and slightly aside. She has natural freckles and pores, shimmery reddish eyeshadow, dark eyeliner, heavy mascara, glossy natural lips, and red metallic heart stickers scattered across her face. A delicate silver septum hoop, multiple small silver ear studs, and ornate silver rings including one pale-green stone are visible. One hand enters at the lower left holding a red translucent heart-shaped lollipop on a white stick near her lips, forming an asymmetrical diagonal; a thin black strap appears at the shoulder. Use soft diffused natural window light at approximately 4700K, minimal shadows, and saturated crimson reserved for the lollipop and stickers. Nikon Z8, 105mm macro lens, eye focus, shallow depth, fine film grain, softly blurred ears and background, and realistic skin texture.
